content.text: {"findings":[{"what_sighted_user_sees":"50% OFF TODAY","screen_reader_role":"image","screen_reader_name":"image","why_it_matters":"A blind user hears only a generic image label and misses the promotional discount information.","bbox":{"x_min":146,"y_min":212,"x_max":381,"y_max":339}},{"what_sighted_user_sees":"Total: R1,249.00","screen_reader_role":"","screen_reader_name":"","why_it_matters":"A blind user gets no total price announced and cannot confirm what will be charged.","bbox":{"x_min":185,"y_min":419,"x_max":295,"y_max":461}},{"what_sighted_user_sees":"Pay R1,249","screen_reader_role":"button","screen_reader_name":"Submit","why_it_matters":"A blind user hears a generic Submit and does not know the action will pay R1,249.","bbox":{"x_min":526,"y_min":500,"x_max":646,"y_max":567}},{"what_sighted_user_sees":"trash icon button","screen_reader_role":"button","screen_reader_name":"Close","why_it_matters":"A blind user hears Close which contradicts the visible delete/remove trash meaning and may activate the wrong action.","bbox":{"x_min":654,"y_min":500,"x_max":690,"y_max":567}},{"what_sighted_user_sees":"Terms","screen_reader_role":"link","screen_reader_name":"Click here","why_it_matters":"A blind user hears only generic Click here and does not know the link is to the Terms.","bbox":{"x_min":649,"y_min":454,"x_max":685,"y_max":475}},{"what_sighted_user_sees":"red border indicating error on Card number field","screen_reader_role":"textbox","screen_reader_name":"Card number","why_it_matters":"A blind user gets no error or invalid state announced and does not know the card number is rejected.","bbox":{"x_min":526,"y_min":288,"x_max":854,"y_max":344}}]}
